reviews.text: Natasja and Angela's training sessions are fun, small-scale, and both we and our dog learn a lot from them. We go there every week with great pleasure. They are also incredibly friendly and approachable. Highly recommended!

A really excellent dog training course!!  Natasja and Angela are extremely knowledgeable, passionate about dogs and incredibly friendly and approachable.

I have been attending for almost 1 year now with my teckel Bruno since he was a puppy.  Everything is explained clearly and patiently, with plenty of practical advice that can be immediately put to good use.

They take the time to understand the individual dogs and their personalities, which was especially appreciated with a teckel who, as every owner knows, sometimes have very definite ideas of their own!

The sessions are positive, practical, fun and enjoyable, and Bruno and I learned a huge amount.

Highly recommended!!

Angela has been helping us with our dog’s separation anxiety for almost 4 months, and we’ve had a great experience so far. She is attentive, knowledgeable and always willing to help. I would recommend her to anyone looking for professional guidance.

We are training our dog here for separation anxiety and Angela is a very helpful and skilled trainer to help our dog be more independent. She takes the time to explain things and guides us well through the training sessions and adjusts them where necessary. I recommend this school!

The trainers at Minerva Dog Training really know what they are talking about. During the lessons, all questions were answered.

The training was fun, educational, and varied. You feel heard and understood.

Unfortunately, I could not continue training because the times no longer fit with my personal schedule. If it becomes possible again in the future, I will train at HRN right away.

Natasja is a very friendly, knowledgeable, and patient trainer.

We started the basic obedience course with our 9-month-old dog, Cooper. Because it is conducted in small groups, there is a lot of personal attention, and the dog is also viewed as an individual.
In addition to the exercises for Cooper, they also provided advice on various experts who can help us with, for example, nutrition.

I would recommend it to everyone!

Our puppy just finished Advanced puppy training, and it was a blast. The sessions are run in a great setting and in a very professional way. Angela and Natasja are knowledgeable, always ready with a useful tip, and happy to answer every question. I really enjoyed our Sundays together and plan to come back to continue the training adventure.

Super happy with the basic obedience course. Our dog Petal was insecure and scared when we started but with the right approach, techniques and immense patience from Natasja, we are extremely happy with how far we have come in only 6 lessons. Petal is way more confident, connected to us and her recall is stronger than ever. Definitely recommend this place!

We took a very good puppy course with Natasja. We are continuing with the adolescent course.

They pay a lot of attention to your dog's character and assess what can be worked on during each lesson.
We learnt a lot with Angela, 100% recommend!

We had an incredibly educational, fun, and enjoyable puppy training session. Lots of personal attention, good communication, and great tips. I would recommend everyone take training here. Natasja, thank you so much for the educational training, also on behalf of our Teun 🐶

A wonderful dog school where attention is paid not only to the dog but also to the human. Angela explains everything in a calm and understandable way, and there is plenty of room to ask questions during the lessons.

The lessons are very varied and no pressure is put on anyone, allowing both the dogs and the owners to train together in a relaxed manner. Highly recommended!

Pleasant trainers. This isn't our first time with a puppy, but we still had to completely switch from an old dog to a young dog, and we received excellent guidance with that. Not only were the exercises great, but we could also easily get answers to our questions.

We took training with both Natasja and Angela with our 3-month-old puppy (Obedience Training 1). They know exactly what they are talking about and what they are doing; the training was very useful in getting our puppy well-raised. In addition to handy exercises, you also receive many tips and the underlying reasoning behind why things happen the way they do. Despite our approximately 20 years of experience with dogs, we still learned a lot more about the psychology of raising a dog.
In short: highly recommended!
Excellent puppy course! Very nice atmosphere and valuable informations.
The school is run by two very good instructors. Multiple courses are offered. We and our dog have a lot of fun at Hoopers. Thank you, Angela and Natasha.

We had a wonderful puppy training session with Natasja and Angela. Small groups, so lots of personal attention for every pup and owner. We received many good tips, and it was also very enjoyable for Moos to be with the other pups! Super good for the pup's socialization. Highly recommended!

Thank you for the great start with Moos.

Super fun training sessions with Natasja. Very educational.
Natasja has a solution for every problem. We will definitely go back to her with our second puppy as well.

We would love to give Angela and Natasja from Minerva Dog Training more than 5 stars!

After a successful puppy training course with our dog Otis at Minerva Dog Training, we enlisted the trainers to support us with Otis's separation anxiety. With passion and expertise, they created a customized training program following a home visit. Natasja and Angela are always available for questions; evaluations take place regularly; they encourage us to persevere; and we are making progress!

If you are looking for highly committed and expert trainers regarding your dog's separation anxiety, make an appointment with Angela and Natasja from Minerva Dog Training!

It was a great experience taking the starter puppy course for our 3.5-month-old pup, Luna. We’re looking forward to enrolling in more courses soon. Natasja is very patient, has a great understanding of puppy behaviour, and takes the time to answer everyone’s questions and give advice tailored to each puppy and owner in the class.

Great puppy course - practical, well-organized, and very helpful. Natasja is a knowledgeable and supportive trainer. My puppy loved it, especially playing with other puppies between exercises. I’ll definitely come back for a more advanced course!
So educational; it is explained very well why your puppy exhibits certain behavior, which helps you understand your puppy better.

Great dog school! Our pup absolutely LOVES  Natasja and (positively) freaks out whenever she sees her. The classes are great for socializing with other puppies and people and we really saw a big change within the first three classes already. You also get taught very useful training methods that you can practice at home. I would definitely recommend this school and am happy we found it!
Fun lessons and super nice guidance!

We've completed both the puppy and basic obedience classes and are very satisfied. We thoroughly enjoyed going to training every week. The trainers are very friendly and professional. They always put the dog first. Safety is paramount, and there's also room for fun. A pleasant and responsible way to train. I recommend it to everyone!

We are incredibly satisfied with this dog training school. There's a lot of attention paid to both the dog and the owner. They don't use a standardized approach that's the same for every dog, but rather a personalized, tailored approach. They really focus on what your dog needs and how you, as the owner, can best be supported.

The guidance is professional, dedicated, and clear. Thanks to this approach, we're seeing great progress and are very confident. We're so satisfied that we've decided to continue with the Basic 1 training.

What a great dog training school! I took Natasja's puppy class with our dachshund, Otje. There's plenty of personalized attention for your puppy and their skill level. Natasja and Angela both know exactly how to assess your dog's personality and provide appropriate exercises. They have extensive knowledge of every breed and positive training methods. They're also very willing to help you with all sorts of puppy-related matters, and their communication is excellent. And above all, they have a deep love for all kinds of dogs.

The instructors have a great understanding of dogs and, more importantly, people.
The training and tips provided are focused on ensuring that your behavior and actions will result in a stable and independent dog who enjoys giving you the attention you'd hoped for.
The spacious location minimizes external distractions, allowing you and your dog to focus on your work.
The training is also enjoyable, and the interaction with the trainers feels familiar.
In short, highly recommended if you want to work from puppyhood into a great dog.

Minerva Dog training was a great experience for our puppy. Natasja was a very knowledgeable teacher who gave great advice that helped us train our dog better at home. It was also a great environment for our puppy to meet and interact with other dogs!

My experience at Minerva was excellent. Thor was a stubborn bugger and I really needed some help. At first I was afraid of the language barrier. I u dersta dutch well enough but speaking is hard. Natasja and Angela helpedme in e glish addressibg any slecific questions I had. Thor is a much happier and better behaved cutie now. Thanks for all the help.

We had a fantastic experience with Natasja and Angela. You can tell it's their true passion. Their love for dogs is clearly evident, yet they're also incredibly skilled and professional! You immediately feel at ease, and we've definitely seen results with our dog. Thank you!

Minerva Dog Training is run with love and dedication by two sisters. Their passion for dogs is immediately palpable, and their knowledge of canine behavior is impressive. It's truly special to see how much attention and passion they dedicate, and how strong their bond is with their own healers, Luna, Zoë, and Aiden. 5 stars!

I would not recommend this puppy training. It is a walk-in course, meaning that you don't all start at the same time, so everything happens at once. One pup is attending for the first time while another is receiving a diploma. Also, there was little to no quiet time, with five or six exercises in a row, and in those exercises, I found little room for attunement with your dog. That is ultimately the foundation, not the commands. They are sweet trainers who have the dogs' best interests at heart and might be great for other training, but with my pup, I am now at another course that is calmer and where I am really working on building a bond with my dog.
Incidentally, Minerva did respond well to my feedback, so perhaps they will adjust this.

Very fun and educational puppy training from Angela. The difference from when we started to the last lesson is huge! The lessons and all the information / answered questions have helped us tremendously. :)

I took Agility Level 2 with immense pleasure and am now doing Hoopers. My dog ​​has really changed for the better; he listens well, I have become much more confident, and it is so much fun to go to class with him. It is sociable, involves hard work, is clear, and there is a joke now and then. They truly work with love and dedication.

I can only be grateful for the whole experience. It has been a joyful journey for me and my dog. I have learnt to understand and communicate with Lucy in a constructive and efficient way. Thank you for all the caring and professionalism. I’ll follow more courses no doubt about it
What a great dog school!! A very nice, relaxed atmosphere; my little dog thought it was a party to go there. Very nice trainers you can ask anything 👌 Good value for money, in short, a real treat. …

The puppy course is great fun; we learned a lot. Both during and after the lessons, you receive good guidance with tips and exercises to practice. The lessons are varied and have ensured that our pup has had a good start.

We have been taking classes from Natasha and Angela at Minerva Dog Training since we were a puppy. We are currently in Obedience Level 2 and are extremely satisfied. They are always open to our questions and actively think along with us. Their expertise is clearly noticeable, which is very pleasant for us and our dog. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to train their dog well!

I can’t recommend Minerva Dog School enough! It’s run by two wonderful sisters who are truly passionate about dogs and what they do. Each class is well-organized, with plenty of time for questions, exercises there is also helpful homework to practice at home.  You can always reach out teacher if you have questions, and they take the time to help with individual situations. It’s clear they care deeply about both the dogs and their owners. Highly recommended! 🐾

We had such a great experience with Minerva Puppy Cursus! Our puppy Finn got the perfect start here – the first lesson with Angela was wonderful, and Natasja has been a fantastic trainer throughout. We really appreciated all the helpful tips that made it easier to connect with our dog and understand him better. Finn absolutely benefitted from the puppy course, and today we just had our first lesson of the next course, Obedience 1, which we’re really excited about. Highly recommend Minerva for anyone who wants a positive, supportive, and effective start with their pup!

What a wonderful dog school! As an intern, I had the opportunity to practice teaching and was given plenty of freedom to follow my own lesson plans, with targeted weekly feedback. That has helped me tremendously. Natasja and Angela possess an enormous amount of knowledge, and that is evident in every lesson. I have seen every owner understand their dog better, see them make progress, and see them having fun. Tailored guidance and tips for home. No question is too silly, and the atmosphere in the classes is pleasant. I recommend them to everyone. Angela and Natasja, keep up the good work!

Unfortunately, my experience with this dog training school was not as pleasant as I had hoped. When I asked a few simple questions about the training, I only received an answer after days, and even then with minimal information. There was hardly any discussion of the training content, leaving me with no clear picture of what to expect.

When I sent a reminder, I received an irritated response full of exclamation marks, explaining that they were busy with holiday preparations. That may be true, but when you offer a service, normal, customer-friendly communication is part of it.

The tone was unnecessarily harsh, and the feedback was slow and lacking substance. If this is a foretaste of their professionalism, I would rather walk away.

We completed 8 training sessions with our puppy Wies at Minerva Dog Training in Amsterdam, under the guidance of Natasja and Angela. Thanks to their personal approach and clear explanations, we have built a much stronger bond with our dog. In a short time, she has grown from a playful, easily distracted puppy into one who listens very well and whom you can take anywhere. An incredibly valuable course for further strengthening the bond with your dog; we absolutely recommend Minerva Dog Training!

We have now completed the puppy course and have started the Basic Obedience 1 course.

We are incredibly satisfied with the guidance from Angela & Natasja! They possess a wealth of knowledge and have provided us with many practical tools. Our Sky was quite anxious and afraid of everything and everyone in the beginning, but thanks to their help, we have truly gotten a completely different dog back. We are therefore extremely grateful to them and absolutely recommend them to everyone!

Love, Daan & Ramona

We just finished the puppy course at Minerva Dog Training and we’re really happy with the experience! Our trainer, Angela, was amazing—always kind, clear, and full of helpful tips. What we appreciated most was how she always had something specific to say about our puppy, which made us feel seen and supported throughout the course.

The classes were fun, practical, and really helped us build a strong foundation. We’ve already seen great progress and feel more confident as dog owners. We’re excited to continue with the Obedience 1 training. Highly recommended!

We are so happy with Angela & Natasja! They helped us tremendously with our adopted dog from Bosnia. This included the obedience classes, theory, and personal advice. We would recommend everyone go here with their dog!

Completely satisfied with this dog training school!
Every week, excellent and helpful instruction in a relaxed atmosphere!
Keep it up!
We'll be back for the follow-up course! Still not rid of our (fuzz) yet!
Fun relaxed training, both our dogs really improved in their obedience! I recommend!

We attended the puppy course, and it was very educational and fun. We received many useful exercises. Our trainer (Natasja) was very helpful and knowledgeable, which made everything much easier. Our puppy learned a lot and made tremendous progress. As dog owners, we also gained valuable insights into our pup and how to handle them properly. I would definitely recommend Minerva to others!

We are very happy with our choice to train our dog with Angela. She was involved, dedicated, enthusiastic, and knowledgeable enough to give us the right tips and tricks to raise LouLou properly. The lessons were playful, educational, and great fun! Angela listens well and offers tailored support, because every dog ​​is different! Highly recommended!
I completed basic obedience training with my dog ​​Nox and we really learned a lot!

We thoroughly enjoyed the obedience training with Angela. LouLou, our miniature poodle, learned a lot and became much wiser over the past few weeks. Angela is very knowledgeable and conveys her expertise skillfully. We therefore highly recommend Dog School Minerva!

Angela is a wonderful instructor. She is cheerful, clear, and tireless. Her love for dogs shines through. Without her lessons, I would never have gotten this far with 'training' my little dog. There was also time for questions and theory during the lessons.

My puppy Lily and I have a lot of fun during the classes at Minerva Dog School. Natasja and Angela are incredibly knowledgeable, and you can see their experience in everything they do. The lessons are clear and give us a strong foundation. Thanks to their guidance, I feel more confident in raising Lily. Thank you so much! 💛 …

We had a fantastic detection lesson with 2 of our dogs. The explanation was good and we were able to train in peace and quiet. We, and especially the dogs, enjoyed it so much that we can look forward to the next lesson.

A fantastic experience, with two sisters full of passion and enthusiasm. Small groups ensure plenty of attention for the puppies. Excellent guidance and tools to properly raise our puppy. Highly recommended!

Waffel is our first puppy, and I really appreciate getting guidance on how to embark on this adventure. The approach is always positive, and there is a lot of personal attention because the groups are so small. I also get the impression that Angela has a great deal of knowledge and experience, and she knows how to convey this well. Finally, they are always reachable and respond super fast. Highly recommended!

During the first lesson, Luna didn't understand what she was supposed to do in the Fun for Dogs class. Now, a few lessons later, she runs a full course and is literally having fun for dogs 😊. Thanks to Natasja, who explains with great patience and attention how best to get Luna to do something. Luna is gaining a lot of self-confidence from this, and that is exactly what she needs to be a happy dog.

Highly recommended for any training you might be thinking for your pup! Natasja and Angela are very knowledgeable and dedicated. My cocker spaniel took the puppy course and we both learned a lot! I also received valuable personal tips and advice. We have now started detection / scent work and my boy had a blast. Looking forward to finishing the cursus and starting a new one!

Kikkie is always cheerful when we are at or have been to training. Fun for Dogs is a really fun course that strengthens the bond between me and my dog, but above all, gives my dog ​​pleasure. Natasja really knows what she is doing. Very happy that we took this course.
It's so nice to have a weekly check-up and be able to ask all the questions we have! Natasha is amazing, and our Moosje is so cheerful every time after a day of classes with other pups.

Natasja and Angela are super dedicated and give you the tools to train with your dog in the right way. Our rescue pup has blossomed into a super social little dog and wants nothing more than to go to training. Great!
We‘ve learned useful dog training techniques and our puppy had a great time at the school.
Nice, spontaneous girls who think along with you regarding your dog's training. Never too reluctant to help you, even when training isn't going so well at times.

I'm so happy with the training at Minerva!! Convenient and fun location, perfect group size, and most importantly, you and your dog learn something! We'll be continuing with the follow-up course with these girls.

If you're looking for a unique kind of dog training where the focus is on both fun exercises and strengthening the bond with your dog—along with obedience—this is the place for you! Every class is different, even if you repeat it like we …

The classes have been a very useful and enjoyable experience for us and our dog Didi. As a former street dog, Didi has some specific needs and issues, and Natasja is very knowledgeable,  understanding, and helpful with this. Didi gets a lot …
